description: This file implements data parallelism for PyTorch modules, defining the DataParallel class and a functional data_parallel method to distribute computations across multiple GPUs.

classes.name: DataParallel
classes.description: A class that implements data parallelism at the module level, allowing a PyTorch module to be replicated and run across multiple GPUs.

methods.name: _check_balance
methods.description: Checks GPU balance and issues warnings if there is significant imbalance in memory or core count.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DataParallel object, setting up device IDs, output device, and module replication.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass by scattering inputs, replicating the module, and gathering outputs.

methods.name: replicate
methods.description: Replicates the module across specified device IDs.

methods.name: scatter
methods.description: Splits inputs and kwargs across device IDs for parallel processing.

methods.name: parallel_apply
methods.description: Applies the replicated modules to inputs in parallel.

methods.name: gather
methods.description: Gathers outputs from multiple devices into a single tensor.
